vsm2.13:1.2: Tattha tato parāsu ca tīsu abhiññāsu so evaṃ samāhite cittetiādīnaṃ (dī. ni. 1.240 ādayo) attho vuttanayeneva veditabbo.
vsm2.13:2.1: Tatra dibbāya sotadhātuyāti ettha dibbasadisattā dibbā.
vsm2.13:2.2: Devānaṃ hi sucaritakammanibbattā pittasemharuhirādīhi apalibuddhā upakkilesavimuttatāya dūrepi ārammaṇaṃ sampaṭicchanasamatthā dibbapasādasotadhātu hoti.
vsm2.13:2.3: Ayañcāpi imassa bhikkhuno vīriyabhāvanābalanibbattā ñāṇasotadhātu tādisāyevāti dibbasadisattā dibbā.
vsm2.13:2.4: Apica dibbavihāravasena paṭiladdhattā attanā ca dibbavihārasannissitattāpi dibbā.
vsm2.13:2.9: Atikkantamānusikāyāti manussūpacāraṃ atikkamitvā saddasavanena mānusikaṃ maṃsasotadhātuṃ atikkantāya vītivattitvā ṭhitāya.
vsm2.13:3.1: Ubho sadde suṇātīti dve sadde suṇāti.
vsm2.13:3.3: Dibbe ca mānuse ca, devānañca manussānañca saddeti vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm2.13:3.5: Ye dūre santike cāti ye saddā dūre paracakkavāḷepi ye ca santike antamaso sadehasannissitapāṇakasaddāpi, te suṇātīti vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm2.13:4.3: parikammasamādhicittena paṭhamataraṃ pakatisotapathe dūre oḷāriko araññe sīhādīnaṃ saddo āvajjitabbo.
vsm2.13:4.4: Vihāre ghaṇḍisaddo, bherisaddo, saṅkhasaddo, sāmaṇeradaharabhikkhūnaṃ sabbathāmena sajjhāyantānaṃ sajjhāyanasaddo,
vsm2.13:4.5: pakatikathaṃ kathentānaṃ ‘‘kiṃ bhante, kimāvuso’’tiādisaddo, sakuṇasaddo, vātasaddo, padasaddo,
vsm2.13:4.6: pakkuthitaudakassa cicciṭāyanasaddo, ātape sussamānatālapaṇṇasaddo, kunthakipillikādisaddoti evaṃ sabboḷārikato pabhuti yathākkamena sukhumasaddā āvajjitabbā.
vsm2.13:4.7: Tena puratthimāya disāya saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasikātabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:4.8: Pacchimāya, uttarāya, dakkhiṇāya, heṭṭhimāya, uparimāya disāya, puratthimāya anudisāya, pacchimāya, uttarāya, dakkhiṇāya anudisāya saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasikātabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:5.1: Tassa te saddā pākatikacittassāpi pākaṭā honti. Parikammasamādhicittassa pana ativiya pākaṭā.
vsm2.13:5.2: Tassevaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasikaroto idāni dibbasotadhātu uppajjissatīti tesu saddesu aññataraṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā manodvārāvajjanaṃ uppajjati.
vsm2.13:5.3: Tasmiṃ niruddhe cattāri pañca vā javanāni javanti, yesaṃ purimāni tīṇi cattāri vā parikammaupacārānulomagotrabhunāmakāni kāmāvacarāni,
vsm2.13:5.4: catutthaṃ pañcamaṃ vā appanācittaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ catutthajjhānikaṃ.
vsm2.13:6.1: Tattha yaṃ tena appanācittena saddhiṃ uppannaṃ ñāṇaṃ, ayaṃ dibbasotadhātūti veditabbā.
vsm2.13:6.2: Tato paraṃ tasmiṃ sote patito hoti.
vsm2.13:6.3: Taṃ thāmajātaṃ karontena ‘‘etthantare saddaṃ suṇāmī’’ti ekaṅgulamattaṃ paricchinditvā vaḍḍhetabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:6.4: Tato dvaṅgulacaturaṅgulaaṭṭhaṅgulavidatthiratanaantogabbhapamukhapāsādapariveṇasaṅghārāmagocaragāmajanapadādivasena yāva cakkavāḷaṃ tato vā bhiyyopi paricchinditvā paricchinditvā vaḍḍhetabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:7.1: Evaṃ adhigatābhiñño esa pādakajjhānārammaṇena phuṭṭhokāsabbhantaragatepi sadde puna pādakajjhānaṃ asamāpajjitvāpi abhiññāñāṇena suṇātiyeva.
vsm2.13:7.2: Evaṃ suṇanto ca sacepi yāva brahmalokā saṅkhabheripaṇavādisaddehi ekakolāhalaṃ hoti, pāṭiyekkaṃ vavatthapetukāmatāya sati
vsm2.13:7.3: ayaṃ saṅkhasaddo ayaṃ bherisaddoti vavatthapetuṃ sakkotiyevāti.
vsm2.13:8.1: Cetopariyañāṇāyāti ettha pariyātīti pariyaṃ, paricchindatīti attho.
vsm2.13:8.7: Veneyyavasena pana desanāvilāsena ca byañjananānattaṃ kataṃ.
vsm2.13:8.8: Cetasā cetoti attano cittena tesaṃ cittaṃ.
vsm2.13:8.9: Paricca pajānātīti paricchinditvā sarāgādivasena nānappakārato jānāti.
vsm2.13:9.2: Etañhi dibbacakkhuvasena ijjhati, taṃ etassa parikammaṃ.
vsm2.13:9.3: Tasmā tena bhikkhunā ālokaṃ vaḍḍhetvā dibbena cakkhunā parassa hadayarūpaṃ nissāya vattamānassa lohitassa vaṇṇaṃ passitvā cittaṃ pariyesitabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:9.4: Yadā hi somanassacittaṃ vattati, tadā rattaṃ nigrodhapakkasadisaṃ hoti.
vsm2.13:9.5: Yadā domanassacittaṃ vattati, tadā kāḷakaṃ jambupakkasadisaṃ.
vsm2.13:9.7: Tasmā tena ‘‘idaṃ rūpaṃ somanassindriyasamuṭṭhānaṃ, idaṃ domanassindriyasamuṭṭhānaṃ, idaṃ upekkhindriyasamuṭṭhāna’’nti parassa hadayalohitavaṇṇaṃ passitvā cittaṃ pariyesantena cetopariyañāṇaṃ thāmagataṃ kātabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:10.1: Evaṃ thāmagate hi tasmiṃ anukkamena sabbampi kāmāvacaracittaṃ rūpāvacarārūpāvacaracittañca pajānāti cittā cittameva saṅkamanto vināpi hadayarūpadassanena.
vsm2.13:10.2: Vuttampi cetaṃ aṭṭhakathāyaṃ ‘‘āruppe parassa cittaṃ jānitukāmo kassa hadayarūpaṃ passati, kassindriyavikāraṃ oloketīti?
vsm2.13:10.4: Iddhimato visayo esa yadidaṃ yattha katthaci cittaṃ āvajjanto soḷasappabhedaṃ cittaṃ jānāti.
vsm2.13:11.1: Sarāgaṃ vā cittantiādīsu pana aṭṭhavidhaṃ lobhasahagataṃ cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:11.3: Dve domanassacittāni dve vicikicchuddhaccacittānīti imāni pana cattāri cittāni imasmiṃ duke saṅgahaṃ na gacchanti.
vsm2.13:11.5: Duvidhaṃ pana domanassacittaṃ sadosaṃ cittaṃ nāma.
vsm2.13:11.7: Sesāni dasākusalacittāni imasmiṃ duke saṅgahaṃ na gacchanti.
vsm2.13:11.9: Samohaṃvītamohanti ettha pana pāṭipuggalikanayena vicikicchuddhaccasahagatadvayameva samohaṃ, mohassa pana sabbākusalesu sambhavato dvādasavidhampi akusalacittaṃ samohaṃ cittanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:12.11: Iti cetopariyañāṇalābhī bhikkhu sabbappakārampi idaṃ sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ…pe… avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajānātīti.
